entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is Isaac, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order number is VF-90210-C.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up for you... VF-90210-C. I see the order here for the VeloPro cycling shoes. I can help with that. To get started, is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?
They're just awful. They give me blisters no matter what I do. I've adjusted the cleats a dozen times. Nothing works.
I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing you discomfort. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. You're looking for a full refund, correct?
Understood. Let me just review the purchase date to check the return eligibility. Please hold.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I see here that the shoes were delivered 35 days ago. Our policy for standard items allows for returns within 90 days, so you're well within that window. I can go ahead and approve this return for you right now.
Fine. I figured it would be a bigger fight.

Not at all. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Just package the shoes, attach the label, and drop them at a post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, we'll process your full refund back to the original payment method.
Whatever. Just make sure the label actually gets sent.
I can confirm it has already been sent from our system. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
